lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kell, 2031. Six timber buildings on a shelf of rock, a well that works, and a smell of cut pine. Nothing is bricked up because nothing has happened yet.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: This is the founding year of my order. I have read the charter every winter of my life and I have never seen the hand that wrote it.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Smells like a building site. Everything worth being afraid of is still in a lab somewhere.

lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: You came up the mountain without a cart and you are not dressed for it. Ilse Kell. I dug the well, so I get to ask what you want.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A second party is already on the terrace: a woman in a good coat with a leather case, and two small flying machines idling above her shoulder.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: Aurelia Vance, counsel to Meridian. I was here first and I am also waiting for an answer.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Auditor. Whatever is decided on this terrace, my order inherits it. So does the village. So does the fortress in 2148 and the free town in 2312.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Speak to Ilse Kell, or to Vance, when you are ready to weigh in.
